Evidence / output: Discover: interview the consenting client and map brief, production, revision and delivery responsibilities.
Scope: agree one organisation, two roles, one campaign, asset/version model, exclusions and spending ceiling.
Prepare: sketch screens, define permissions, source/rights registers, job states and acceptance tests.
Build: create the Lovable portal and manual asset review loop; use a controlled GitHub/Claude Code development handoff.
Integrate and evaluate: add one authorised provider API at a time behind server endpoints, then test jobs, callbacks, access and failures.
Release: rehearse rollback/restore, resolve blockers and invite one approved real pilot client.
Operate: complete a real review/revision cycle and seven days of appropriate monitoring and spend review.
Hand over: deliver code, configuration instructions, creative source files, costs, support ownership and shutdown plan.
